profile.name: Ankit
profile.role: Computer Science student · ML engineering & research
profile.headline: Learning deeply. Building from first principles.
profile.bio: I build machine learning projects and explore the ideas behind language models, one paper and implementation at a time.

about:
I'm a B.Tech Computer Science student at BIT Mesra, working toward a future in AI research. My interests center on language models and generative AI.

I learn by reading papers, unpacking the mathematics, and implementing the underlying ideas in PyTorch. This portfolio brings that work together, alongside projects that apply machine learning to useful problems.

projects.title: LLM from Scratch
projects.summary: Exploring language model fundamentals through attention implementations in PyTorch.
projects.body: Building and understanding language model components from first principles. This project connects attention equations with working PyTorch implementations.

projects.title: PaperLens
projects.summary: A research paper search project exploring hybrid retrieval, transformer retrieval, and reranking.
projects.body: A project exploring lexical and semantic retrieval for research papers, followed by reranking. Evaluation notes and verified results can be added here.

projects.title: Campus AI Assistant
projects.summary: An academic assistant project built around document retrieval, summaries, and study questions.
projects.body: An academic assistant in development, with document processing, chunking, PostgreSQL and pgvector retrieval, summaries, and study questions.
